auction_id: <AUCTION_ID: 64 hex chars, the --id of every command>
lot: <LOT LABEL: free text, e.g. uniform round>
supply: <SUPPLY: units on offer; the harness scenario uses 1>
reserve_zats: <RESERVE_ZATS: decimal zatoshis; the harness scenario uses 10>
tick_zats: <TICK_ZATS: decimal zatoshis; the harness scenario uses 10>
B_max_zats: <B_MAX_ZATS: per-bid cap in decimal zatoshis; the harness scenario uses 3000>
q_max: <Q_MAX: max quantity per bid; the harness scenario uses 1>
C_zats: <C_ZATS: collateral per bid in decimal zatoshis; the harness scenario uses 200000>
fee_zats: <FEE_ZATS: decimal zatoshis; the harness scenario uses 0>
deposit_addresses: <ESCROW_UA again: deposit slot 0 is the escrow UA from auction keys>
reserve_return_ua_commitment: <RESERVE_RETURN_UA_COMMITMENT: set by auction create --config — DELETE this line, never type it by hand (H15)>
